name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.mem_strictWeightedSimplex

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.column_mem_iff
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {w0 H : ℝ} {w : Fin m → ℝ},
  0 < w0 →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < w i) →
      ∀ (a : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ),
        a ∈ OAI.PiExponent.realWeightedSimplex (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.columnWeights w0 w) H ↔
          w0 * ↑(a 0) + ∑ i, w i * ↑(a i.succ) ≤ H

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.row_mem_iff
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {v0 θ H : ℝ} {w : Fin m → ℝ},
  0 < v0 →
    0 < θ →
      (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < w i) →
        ∀ (b : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ),
          b ∈ OAI.PiExponent.strictWeightedSimplex (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.rowWeights v0 θ w) H ↔
            v0 * ↑(b 0) + (∑ i, w i * ↑(b i.succ)) / θ < H

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.column_weight_le

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.row_weight_lt

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.log_lcm_power_product_le

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.log_lcm_floor_product_le
prettyType:

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.sum_ceil_truncation_div_le
prettyType:

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.truncation_denominator_log_le
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (F v H : ℝ),
  0 ≤ F →
    0 < v →
      0 < H →
        (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < w i) →
          Real.log (∏ i ∈ s, ↑⌈F * w i / v⌉₊.lcmUpto ^ ⌊H / w i⌋₊) / H ≤
            OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.lcmConstant * F * ↑s.card / v +
              OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.lcmConstant * ∑ i ∈ s, 1 / w i

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.column_log_cost_le
prettyType: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (a q : ι → ℕ), ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(a i) * Real.log ↑(q i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(a i) * ↑⌈Real.log ↑(q i)⌉₊

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.sum_exponents_le_weight_div
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) (wmin : ℝ),
  0 < wmin → (∀ i ∈ s, wmin ≤ w i) → ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(a i) ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, ↑(a i) * w i) / wmin

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.row_log_cost_lower
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (a q : ι → ℕ) (wmin U : ℝ),
  0 < wmin →
    (∀ i ∈ s, wmin ≤ ↑⌈Real.log ↑(q i)⌉₊) →
      ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(a i) * ↑⌈Real.log ↑(q i)⌉₊ ≤ U →
        ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(a i) * ↑⌈Real.log ↑(q i)⌉₊ - U / wmin ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(a i) * Real.log ↑(q i)

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.normalized_arithmetic_bound
prettyType:
∀ (M H b E δ logD columnCost rowCost logAbsDet : ℝ),
  0 < M →
    0 < H →
      -M * logD - columnCost + rowCost ≤ logAbsDet →
        logD ≤ H * E → columnCost ≤ M * H → M * H * b - M * H * δ ≤ rowCost → -(1 - b) - (E + δ) ≤ logAbsDet / (M * H)

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.log_denominator_le
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {q : Fin m → ℕ} (F v0 H : ℝ),
  0 ≤ F →
    0 < v0 →
      0 < H →
        (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q i) →
          Real.log
              (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.denominator q (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.truncationOrders q F v0)
                H) ≤
            H *
              (OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.lcmConstant * F * ↑m / v0 +
                OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.lcmConstant * ∑ i, 1 / OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q i)

name: _private.Theorems.Thm_OAI_PiExponent_MatrixArithmetic_selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound.0.OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selected_column_log_cost_le
prettyType:

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selectedMinor_arithmetic_lower_bound
prettyType:
∀ {m K : ℕ} {w0 v0 θ F H wmin : ℝ} (p : Fin m → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 2 ≤ q i) →
    0 < K →
      0 < w0 →
        0 < v0 →
          0 < θ →
            0 ≤ F →
              0 < H →
                0 < wmin →
                  (∀ (i : Fin m), wmin ≤ OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q i) →
                    ∀
                      (selection :
                        OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q) H →
                          OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Column w0 (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q)
                            H),
                      (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selectedMinor K w0 v0 θ F H p q selection).det ≠ 0 →
                        -(1 - OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.meanRowWeight K v0 θ q H) -
                            (OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.lcmConstant * F * ↑m / v0 +
                                OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.lcmConstant *
                                  ∑ i, 1 / OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q i +
                              θ / wmin) ≤
                          Real.log ‖(OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selectedMinor K w0 v0 θ F H p q selection).det‖ /
                            (↑(Fintype.card
                                  (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ
                                    (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q) H)) *
                              H)
